GETTING STARTED

1. War Command (Dashboard)

Your central hub for accessing all conflict intelligence modules. Provides an overview of system capabilities and quick links to major features.

2. Strategy Hub

AI-powered strategic analysis center featuring:

  • Strategic analysis generation based on current conflicts
  • Proactive threat alerts with early warning systems
  • Custom scenario builder for "what-if" analysis
  • Enhanced scenario simulator with sensitivity analysis
  • Collaboration tools for team-based planning
  • Scenario branching and version control

3. Real-time Data Hub

Live intelligence aggregation with:

  • Threat intelligence feed from OSINT sources
  • Breaking news monitoring
  • Economic indicators tracking
  • Satellite intelligence
  • Social media sentiment analysis
  • Historical cross-reference analysis

4. Current Wars

Monitor active conflicts with real-time updates, threat briefings, escalation predictions, and interactive mapping.

5. Past Wars

Access comprehensive historical conflict database with:

  • 100+ historical wars with detailed data
  • Comparative analysis tools
  • War debriefing with AI predictions vs. reality
  • Search by country, war name, or century

6. Future Wars

AI-driven conflict prediction featuring:

  • Predictability analysis with probability forecasts
  • Inevitable war scenarios based on current trends
  • Galactic/far-future conflict projections
  • Climate-resource-conflict network analysis
  • Policy intervention simulator

7. Conflict Simulator

Build and simulate custom geopolitical scenarios with AI-powered outcome analysis, counter-strategy generation, and scenario evolution tracking.

AI ANALYSIS FEATURES

STRATEGIC ANALYSIS - Click "GENERATE ANALYSIS" in Strategy Hub to create comprehensive strategic assessments

PROACTIVE ALERTS - Generate early warning alerts for emerging flashpoints

THREAT INTEL - Subscribe to specific regions/threat types in Real-time Data Hub

EXTERNAL DATA - Integrate RSS/API feeds with automated AI contextualization

NARRATIVE GENERATOR - AI creates realistic news reports, diplomatic cables, intel briefs from simulation data

HISTORICAL WHAT-IF - Alter historical events and simulate alternate timelines with butterfly effect analysis

POLICY ENGINE - AI generates diplomatic/economic/military/humanitarian policy recommendations

SCENARIO BUILDING

Multiple creation methods available in Conflict Simulator:

  • Manual Builder: Create custom scenarios with specific parameters
  • AI Generation: Auto-generate realistic war scenarios from brief prompts
  • Fictional Wars: Create alternative history scenarios with unique narratives
  • AI Opponents: Design adaptive adversaries with custom aggression/doctrine
  • Collaborative Mode: Invite team members, assign roles, add comments and tasks

After creation:

  1. Run simulation to generate outcomes and predictions
  2. Review AI Strategy Advisor recommendations
  3. Create what-if branches from any simulation round
  4. Compare branches with visual charts and summary tables
  5. Generate policy recommendations based on outcomes
  6. Create narrative documents (news, briefs, cables)
  7. Share and collaborate with team members

ADVANCED FEATURES

  • Predictive Trends: AI projects threat levels 30/60/90 days ahead with inflection points
  • Red Team Analysis: Challenge threat assessments with alternative interpretations and blind spot identification
  • Scenario Modeling: Simulate best/worst/likely outcomes for counter-strategies with failure mode analysis
  • Auto-Contextualization: External feeds automatically trigger AI analysis when new data arrives
  • Cross-Platform Integration: World Bank, UN, ACLED, SIPRI data with correlation analysis
  • Historical What-If: Alter past events and explore butterfly effects through alternate timelines
  • Natural Language Alerts: Create complex alert rules using plain English
  • Interactive Regions: Draw custom map areas for targeted threat analysis

SCENARIO BRANCHING

Visual tree structure for parallel scenario exploration:

  1. Click "FORK" to create a new branch with a "what-if" question
  2. Navigate branches by clicking on them in the tree view
  3. Select multiple branches and click "MERGE" to combine insights
  4. Use "REVERT" button to return to any previous state
  5. AI Strategy Advisor auto-suggests high-value branches to explore
  6. Compare outcomes across branches with visualization charts

SETTINGS & CUSTOMIZATION

Navigate to Settings to configure:

  • Audio: Background music (10% default), sound effects, volume controls
  • Display: Choose from 5 background effects (changes apply instantly)
  • Data Refresh: Configure intervals for wars, predictions, real-time feeds
  • Developer (Admin only): Upload music, videos, and sound effect files

INTERACTIVE MAPS

Dashboard features two map types:

  • Global Threat Matrix: Click markers to view active conflicts, threat zones, and strategic resources
  • Threat Heatmap: Visual representation of predicted escalation zones updated in real-time

Maps auto-refresh every 5 seconds with latest intelligence.

ABOUT WAR MATRIX

MISSION

War Matrix is an advanced geopolitical intelligence platform providing comprehensive conflict analysis, prediction, and strategic simulation. Integrating AI analytics with real-time data, interactive threat mapping, and adaptive scenario generation across all timelines—historical, current, near-future, and speculative galactic eras.

CAPABILITIES

  • Real-Time Intelligence: Interactive maps with threat heatmaps and dynamic conflict tracking
  • AI Analysis: Predictive insights, counter-narratives, red team assessments, and automated branch suggestions
  • Historical Database: 100+ conflicts with pattern recognition, comparative tools, and what-if analysis
  • Advanced Simulation: AI opponents, fictional scenarios, visual branching trees with comparison views
  • Strategy Advisor: Tailored recommendations with diplomatic, military, and information warfare strategies
  • Multi-Domain Integration: Climate, resources, economics, technology, social factors, and external data platforms
  • Narrative Generation: AI-created news reports, diplomatic cables, intelligence briefs from simulation data
  • Policy Recommendations: Comprehensive diplomatic/economic/military/humanitarian strategies with success modeling
  • Collaboration Tools: Multi-user scenario planning with comments, tasks, and activity tracking

TECHNOLOGY

Cutting-edge technology stack:

  • Advanced Language Models with internet data integration
  • Real-time threat processing and heatmap generation
  • Interactive geospatial visualization with Leaflet
  • Dynamic scenario branching with merge/revert capabilities
  • Customizable visual effects and immersive audio system
